% TikZ code representing the transformation of a graph to a d-regular instance
% where each vertex of degree d_v is replaced by a cluster of d_v vertices.
% The nodes inside each cluster are arranged as regular polygons, oriented
% to face directly towards the edges connected to them.
% Here, the graph is a wheel W_6 (one center of degree 5, five outer of degree 3).
% Generated by Antigravity on 2026-07-19.

% Parameters describing how large around the nodes the clouds should be
\providecommand{\cloudsize}{0.58}
\providecommand{\trianglecloudsize}{0.70}

\begin{tikzpicture}[
    scale=0.8,
    vertex/.style={circle, draw=black!80, fill=white, minimum size=15pt, inner sep=0pt, thick},
    mini/.style={circle, draw=black!85, fill=black!85, minimum size=4pt, inner sep=0pt},
    edge/.style={thick, draw=black!80},
    blob/.style={draw=blue!50!black!40, fill=blue!5, thick, rounded corners=8pt},
    centerblob/.style={draw=blue!50!black!40, fill=blue!5, thick, rounded corners=4pt}
]

    % ==================== LEFT GRAPH (Wheel W_6) ====================
    % Edges (drawn first so nodes sit on top)
    % Outer cycle
    \draw[edge] (0, 1.8) -- (1.712, 0.556);
    \draw[edge] (1.712, 0.556) -- (1.058, -1.456);
    \draw[edge] (1.058, -1.456) -- (-1.058, -1.456);
    \draw[edge] (-1.058, -1.456) -- (-1.712, 0.556);
    \draw[edge] (-1.712, 0.556) -- (0, 1.8);
    % Spokes to center
    \draw[edge] (0, 0) -- (0, 1.8);
    \draw[edge] (0, 0) -- (1.712, 0.556);
    \draw[edge] (0, 0) -- (1.058, -1.456);
    \draw[edge] (0, 0) -- (-1.058, -1.456);
    \draw[edge] (0, 0) -- (-1.712, 0.556);

    % Vertices
    \node[vertex] at (0, 0) {};
    \node[vertex] at (0, 1.8) {};
    \node[vertex] at (1.712, 0.556) {};
    \node[vertex] at (1.058, -1.456) {};
    \node[vertex] at (-1.058, -1.456) {};
    \node[vertex] at (-1.712, 0.556) {};


    % ==================== RIGHT GRAPH (Transformed Wheel) ====================
    % Blobs / Clusters (Regular rounded polygons in the background, scaled by their sizes)
    % Center Cloud (Pentagon rotated so corners match node positions, with smaller rounding to prevent inversion)
    \draw[centerblob] ({5.8 + \cloudsize*cos(90)}, {\cloudsize*sin(90)}) -- 
                 ({5.8 + \cloudsize*cos(18)}, {\cloudsize*sin(18)}) -- 
                 ({5.8 + \cloudsize*cos(306)}, {\cloudsize*sin(306)}) -- 
                 ({5.8 + \cloudsize*cos(234)}, {\cloudsize*sin(234)}) -- 
                 ({5.8 + \cloudsize*cos(162)}, {\cloudsize*sin(162)}) -- cycle;
    % Outer Clouds (Triangles, with reverted \trianglecloudsize=0.70 and R=1.6)
    \draw[blob] ({5.8 + \trianglecloudsize*cos(270)}, {1.6 + \trianglecloudsize*sin(270)}) -- ({5.8 + \trianglecloudsize*cos(150)}, {1.6 + \trianglecloudsize*sin(150)}) -- ({5.8 + \trianglecloudsize*cos(30)}, {1.6 + \trianglecloudsize*sin(30)}) -- cycle;
    \draw[blob] ({7.322 + \trianglecloudsize*cos(198)}, {0.494 + \trianglecloudsize*sin(198)}) -- ({7.322 + \trianglecloudsize*cos(78)}, {0.494 + \trianglecloudsize*sin(78)}) -- ({7.322 + \trianglecloudsize*cos(318)}, {0.494 + \trianglecloudsize*sin(318)}) -- cycle;
    \draw[blob] ({6.740 + \trianglecloudsize*cos(126)}, {-1.294 + \trianglecloudsize*sin(126)}) -- ({6.740 + \trianglecloudsize*cos(6)}, {-1.294 + \trianglecloudsize*sin(6)}) -- ({6.740 + \trianglecloudsize*cos(246)}, {-1.294 + \trianglecloudsize*sin(246)}) -- cycle;
    \draw[blob] ({4.860 + \trianglecloudsize*cos(54)}, {-1.294 + \trianglecloudsize*sin(54)}) -- ({4.860 + \trianglecloudsize*cos(294)}, {-1.294 + \trianglecloudsize*sin(294)}) -- ({4.860 + \trianglecloudsize*cos(174)}, {-1.294 + \trianglecloudsize*sin(174)}) -- cycle;
    \draw[blob] ({4.278 + \trianglecloudsize*cos(342)}, {0.494 + \trianglecloudsize*sin(342)}) -- ({4.278 + \trianglecloudsize*cos(222)}, {0.494 + \trianglecloudsize*sin(222)}) -- ({4.278 + \trianglecloudsize*cos(102)}, {0.494 + \trianglecloudsize*sin(102)}) -- cycle;

    % Inter-cluster Edges
    % Spokes (Center to outer)
    \draw[edge] (5.8, 0.28) -- (5.8, 1.32);
    \draw[edge] (6.066, 0.087) -- (7.056, 0.407);
    \draw[edge] (5.965, -0.227) -- (6.575, -1.067);
    \draw[edge] (5.635, -0.227) -- (5.025, -1.067);
    \draw[edge] (5.534, 0.087) -- (4.544, 0.407);
    % Outer cycle
    \draw[edge] (6.042, 1.74) -- (7.38, 0.768);
    \draw[edge] (7.53, 0.307) -- (7.018, -1.265);
    \draw[edge] (6.626, -1.550) -- (4.974, -1.550);
    \draw[edge] (4.582, -1.265) -- (4.07, 0.307);
    \draw[edge] (4.22, 0.768) -- (5.558, 1.74);

    % Mini-vertices (Oriented Regular Polygons)
    % Center Cluster C' (Regular Pentagon pointing to the 5 spokes)
    \node[mini] at (5.8, 0.28) {};
    \node[mini] at (6.066, 0.087) {};
    \node[mini] at (5.965, -0.227) {};
    \node[mini] at (5.635, -0.227) {};
    \node[mini] at (5.534, 0.087) {};

    % Cluster C_1' (Triangle pointing down to face center spoke)
    \node[mini] at (5.8, 1.32) {};
    \node[mini] at (5.558, 1.74) {};
    \node[mini] at (6.042, 1.74) {};

    % Cluster C_2' (Triangle pointing down-left to face center spoke)
    \node[mini] at (7.056, 0.407) {};
    \node[mini] at (7.38, 0.768) {};
    \node[mini] at (7.53, 0.307) {};

    % Cluster C_3' (Triangle pointing up-left to face center spoke)
    \node[mini] at (6.575, -1.067) {};
    \node[mini] at (7.018, -1.265) {};
    \node[mini] at (6.626, -1.550) {};

    % Cluster C_4' (Triangle pointing up-right to face center spoke)
    \node[mini] at (5.025, -1.067) {};
    \node[mini] at (4.974, -1.550) {};
    \node[mini] at (4.582, -1.265) {};

    % Cluster C_5' (Triangle pointing down-right to face center spoke)
    \node[mini] at (4.544, 0.407) {};
    \node[mini] at (4.07, 0.307) {};
    \node[mini] at (4.22, 0.768) {};

\end{tikzpicture}
